name: Hito no Tokoyume
source:
Hanamushi Tuna, who is dressed in elegant white clothes, and Sango, who is dressed in black with a mysterious atmosphere.

Within a limited amount of time, the two go to the place of memories written in their father's diary.

It seems that the experiences the two of them have had will strengthen their feelings...?

[Translated from [url=https://nemurita.booth.pm/items/5380707]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
身着优雅白衣的花虫金枪鱼和一身黑衣充满神秘气息的三吾。

在有限的时间内，两人前往父亲日记中写下回忆的地方。

看来两人的经历会让他们的感情更加深厚……？

[译自[url=https://nemurita.booth.pm/items/5380707]BOOTH[/url]]
